lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}觉得呢，Sensei？

lines.en: : Wanna go on a little night time date with Onee-san? Or do you {i}not{/i} need to get anything out of your system after all?
lines.zh: : 想跟姐姐去来一场小小的夜间约会吗？还是说你{i}并不{/i}需要把体内的东西排出来？

lines.en: : Chinami thinks......Papa should go with big sis Chika.......since she doesn’t want her.......to get lonely.....
lines.zh: : Chinami 觉得……爸爸应该跟 Chika 姐姐去……因为她不想让她……感到孤单……

lines.en: : My {i}system{/i} is fine and you’re not my Onee-san. I’ll just...stay here with Chinami. It makes more sense than going out and potentially being abducted.
lines.zh: : 我的{i}系统{/i}很好，而且你不是我姐姐。我就……留在这儿陪 Chinami。这比出门、还有可能被拐走合理多了。

lines.en: : Ch-Ch-Ch-Chinami thinks this is a bad idea! You can still be abducted if you stay here! Chinami has business dealings with all sorts of nefarious people! They could do the abducting!
lines.zh: : Ch——Ch——Ch——Chinami 觉得这是个坏主意！你留在这儿也可能被拐走！Chinami 跟各种各样的坏人都有生意往来！他们能干拐人的事！

lines.en: : I’m sure Sensei can figure out what to do if you have any {i}nefarious{/i} business dealings tonight, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 我确定如果你今晚有什么{i}坏{/i}生意往来，Sensei 能想出该怎么办，Chinami。

lines.en: : It’ll be no different from all of the other times he’s come over here to watch you.
lines.zh: : 这跟他以前过来照看你那么多次没什么区别。

lines.en: : ARE YOU CRAZY?! YES IT WILL! CHINAMI ISN’T MENTALLY PREPARED TO DEAL WITH CUTE BOYS YET!
lines.zh: : 你疯了吗？！当然有区别！Chinami 还没做好心理准备应付可爱的男孩！
: 你觉得我可爱，Chinami？
: AAABAGHAABBAGABABBABABBBABB!!!???!!!

lines.en: : Just relax. Your Papa is {i}still{/i} your Papa. And talking to him is a good way to...I don’t know. Practice for when you’re able to leave the house one day?
lines.zh: : 放松点。你爸爸{i}还是{/i}你爸爸。跟他聊天是个好办法……我不知道。就当是为将来你能出门那天做练习？
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHH!

lines.en: : I’ll be back in like twenty minutes, okay? The convenience store should have enough to hold us over for a few days.
lines.zh: : 我大概二十分钟后回来，好吗？便利店的东西应该够我们撑几天。

lines.en: : Why do you hate Chinami now?
lines.zh: : 你现在为什么讨厌 Chinami？

lines.en: : {i}Be good for Sensei, okay?! And don’t open the door for Yumi under any circumstances or we may never see him again!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}听 Sensei 的话，好吗？！还有，任何情况下都别给 Yumi 开门，不然我们可能再也见不到他了！{/i}

lines.en: : WHY DO YOU HATE CHINAMI NOW?!?!?!
lines.zh: : 你现在为什么讨厌 Chinami？！？！？！
: Chika 姐姐！等等——

lines.en: : AAAAAAAAAAHHHHHH! CHINAMI IS ALONE WITH A BOY HER OWN AGE!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！Chinami 跟一个同龄男孩单独在一起了！

lines.en: : I’m not {i}your age,{/i} Chinami. I just...look that way right now.
lines.zh: : 我不是{i}你那个年纪{/i}，Chinami。我只是……现在看起来像而已。

lines.en: : You sound like it too. Papa’s voice is deeper, but nice. It always makes Chinami comfortable when she hears it.
lines.zh: : 你听起来也像。爸爸的声音更低，但很好听。Chinami 每次听到都觉得安心。

lines.en: : Then...would it help if I just didn’t speak at all?
lines.zh: : 那……如果我干脆完全不说话会有帮助吗？

lines.en: : Maybe...if you go stand in the corner.
lines.zh: : 也许……如果你去站到角落里的话。

lines.en: : Just ‘til big sis Chika gets back.
lines.zh: : 就站到 Chika 姐姐回来为止。

lines.en: : Can we just...talk the way we normally do instead? You’re the first person I’ve seen all day that I don’t have to look up to speak to.
lines.zh: : 我们能不能就……像平常那样说话？你是我今天见到的第一个不用抬头就能跟她说话的人。
: Chinami……

lines.en: : Chinami’s not so sure if that’s a good idea.
lines.zh: : Chinami 不太确定那是不是个好主意。

lines.en: : She...doesn’t want to get in big Sis Chika’s way. And if her heart starts beating any faster than it is right now, she might {i}actually{/i} die.
lines.zh: : 她……不想妨碍 Chika 姐姐。而且如果她的心跳再比现在快一点，她可能{i}真的{/i}会死。

lines.en: : You have an autoimmune disorder, not heart issues.
lines.zh: : 你得的是自身免疫病，不是心脏问题。

lines.en: : Chinami thinks...Papa might have given her heart issues.
lines.zh: : Chinami 觉得……是爸爸让她得了心脏问题。
: Chosokabe 家……显然有{i}特定的类型{/i}。

lines.en: : Um...can Chinami...ask one teensy little question?
lines.zh: : 呃……Chinami 能……问一个超级小的问题吗？

lines.en: : What did big sis Chika mean when she said that Tsubasa is going to turn you back?...
lines.zh: : Chika 姐姐说 Tsubasa 会把你变回去，是什么意思？……

lines.en: : I...thought that was pretty obvious. She probably has a way to undo whatever has happened to me.
lines.zh: : 我……以为那挺明显的。她大概有办法撤销发生在我身上的事。
: 那如果……她{i}不{/i}那么做……
: 你就会永远保持 Chinami 这个年纪？

lines.en: : I...guess so. But that’s not something I have any interest in doing. Even {i}if{/i} it’s a way for me to go back.
lines.zh: : 我……猜是的。但那不是我感兴趣的事。就算{i}那{/i}是让我回去的办法也一样。
: 那……爸爸喜欢当大人？

lines.en: : I think it’s more that I just hate being a kid.
lines.zh: : 我觉得更多只是我讨厌当小孩。

lines.en: : Chinami agrees! Big sis Chika has so much freedom! She can go to maid cafes and make money! All Chinami can do is stay in this house and play games on her phone! She wants to be an adult too!
lines.zh: : Chinami 同意！Chika 姐姐有好多自由！她可以去女仆咖啡厅还能赚钱！Chinami 能做的只是待在这栋房子里用手机玩游戏！她也想当大人！

lines.en: : Please tell me this isn’t about to lead to you wanting to seize this opportunity to “do things adults do.”
lines.zh: : 请告诉我这不会引出你想抓住这个机会「做大人的事」。

lines.en: : If you’re talking about taxes, Chinami already knows how to do those.
lines.zh: : 如果你说的是报税，Chinami 已经会了。

lines.en: : Okay, good. So there is still {i}some{/i} innocence left in this world.
lines.zh: : 好，很好。所以这个世界上还剩下{i}一些{/i}纯真。

lines.en: : If Chinami can stay calm for the next twenty minutes, maybe she can learn what it’s like to be...normal.
lines.zh: : 如果 Chinami 接下来二十分钟能保持冷静，也许她就能体会到……正常是什么感觉。
: 正常……是指——

lines.en: : If Chinami was able to go to school, she probably wouldn’t be so afraid of boys. She might even...be popular like big sis Chika probably is!
lines.zh: : 如果 Chinami 能去上学，她大概就不会那么怕男孩了。她甚至可能……像 Chika 姐姐大概那样受欢迎！

lines.en: : But Chinami...didn’t think that would ever be possible. So now she’s very confused and...{i}scared...{/i}but she also knows that this...could be the only chance she ever has.
lines.zh: : 但 Chinami……以为那永远不可能。所以现在她非常困惑……又{i}害怕……{/i}但她也知道，这……可能是她唯一的机会。

lines.en: : L...Let’s go sit on the couch! Chinami will...make Papa tea!
lines.zh: : 我……我们去沙发上坐吧！Chinami 来……给爸爸泡茶！

lines.en: : Chinami must apologize for her previous suggestion. It did not occur to her that she doesn’t know how to make tea.
lines.zh: : Chinami 必须为刚才的建议道歉。她没想到自己不会泡茶。

lines.en: : I’d help if I could only reach the cabinet...
lines.zh: : 要是我够得到柜子，我就帮忙了……

lines.en: : Being little sure is tough, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 当小孩确实挺难的，对吧？

lines.en: : That’s an understatement. This has been the worst day of my life.
lines.zh: : 这说法太轻了。这是我人生中最糟的一天。

lines.en: : You...like being a grown up that much?
lines.zh: : 你……就那么喜欢当大人吗？

lines.en: : It’s mostly just the fact that I {i}grew up{/i} already. I don’t want to have to do it again. It’s like literal decades worth of progress were just...wiped away.
lines.zh: : 主要只是我已经{i}长大{/i}了。我不想再来一遍。就好像整整几十年的进展被……抹掉了。

lines.en: : But I guess none of that was really “progress” in the first place when I really start to think about it.
lines.zh: : 不过仔细想想，我猜那些根本算不上「进展」。

lines.en: : I just hate drawing attention to myself. And since everyone knows what I’m {i}supposed{/i} to look like, I’m not going to be able to escape any of that until Tsubasa does...whatever it is Tsubasa can do.
lines.zh: : 我只是讨厌引人注目。而既然所有人都知道我{i}本该{/i}长什么样，在 Tsubasa 做……不管 Tsubasa 能做什么之前，我都逃不掉这些。

lines.en: : Chinami wonders if maybe Tsubasa can turn {i}her{/i} into an adult too?
lines.zh: : Chinami 想知道，Tsubasa 是不是也能把{i}她{/i}变成大人？

lines.en: : Yeah...maybe. I don’t really know how it works.
lines.zh: : 是啊……也许吧。我其实不知道那是怎么运作的。

lines.en: : Do you think we’d be friends if we were really the same age, Papa?
lines.zh: : 爸爸，如果我们真的一样大，你觉得我们会是朋友吗？
: 大概不会。
: 呃！Chinami 的心脏！她的病！

lines.en: : I just mean that there isn’t really anything we have in common. And that scenario gets even more complicated when you bring your sister into the picture.
lines.zh: : 我只是说我们其实没什么共同点。而如果把你姐姐也算进来，那种情形就更复杂了。

lines.en: : But Chinami doesn’t have much in common with Tsukasa and she’s really good friends with her.
lines.zh: : 但 Chinami 跟 Tsukasa 也没什么共同点，可她们是很好的朋友。

lines.en: : Well then maybe we {i}would{/i} be friends. Because that entire family always finds a way to mess with my life. And if Tsukasa was the same age as me, I imagine she’d try and buy me as a pet or something.
lines.zh: : 那也许我们{i}真的会{/i}成为朋友。因为那一整家子总能找到办法来搅乱我的人生。而如果 Tsukasa 跟我同岁，我想她会试着把我当宠物买下来什么的。

lines.en: : Maybe, if you’re still a kid tomorrow, Chinami can invite her over and all three of us can play together?
lines.zh: : 也许，如果你明天还是小孩，Chinami 可以请她过来，我们三个一起玩？

lines.en: : I’d prefer you keep this as secret as possible, Chinami. I haven’t even told my niece yet.
lines.zh: : 我更希望你把这件事尽量保密，Chinami。我连我侄女都还没告诉。

lines.en: : Then...Chinami and Papa have a secret?
lines.zh: : 那……Chinami 和爸爸有秘密了？

lines.en: : {i}And{/i} Chika. And Tsubasa. And Ayane and Maya and Nodoka and Kirin and...{i}Otoha.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}还有{/i} Chika。还有 Tsubasa。还有 Ayane、Maya、Nodoka、Kirin 和……{i}Otoha。{/i}

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t know who most of those people are but can sense that this “Otoha” girl might actually be evil. Either way, a lot of people seem to know this secret!
lines.zh: : Chinami 不知道那些人大部分是谁，但能感觉到这个「Otoha」女孩可能真的是坏人。不管怎样，好像有很多人都知道这个秘密！

lines.en: : Unfortunately so. But maybe we can prevent anyone {i}else{/i} from getting dragged into it if I can just stay here until it all blows over?
lines.zh: : 很不幸，是的。但也许只要我待在这儿等风头过去，我们就能防止{i}别的{/i}人被卷进来？

lines.en: : Chinami will be sad when that happens, though. She always feels left out watching the grown-ups have fun together. So whenever she gets to feel normal, she’s really happy.
lines.zh: : 不过那样的话 Chinami 会难过。看着大人们一起玩闹，她总觉得自己被排除在外。所以每当她有机会感觉自己正常，她都会特别开心。

lines.en: : Or scared. Like you are of me.
lines.zh: : 或者害怕。就像你怕我那样。

lines.en: : Chinami’s more scared of the way Papa makes her feel than of Papa himself.
lines.zh: : Chinami 更怕的是爸爸让她产生的感觉，而不是爸爸本人。

lines.en: : You...really shouldn’t say stuff like that to me, Chinami. It’s harder to talk myself out of things when I have a way to rationalize and excuse them.
lines.zh: : 你……真的不该跟我说这种话，Chinami。当我有了把事情合理化、找借口的办法时，就更难说服自己别做了。

lines.en: : What are you trying to talk yourself out of?
lines.zh: : 你想说服自己别做什么？

lines.en: : Something I’ll...tell you when you’re older.
lines.zh: : 一件等你长大……我再告诉你的事。

lines.en: : Booooo! Chinami is finally old enough in the context of Papa’s world to hear his references and he {i}still{/i} won’t tell her. Maybe he really does hate Chinami after all? Why does everyone hate Chinami now?
lines.zh: : 嘘——！Chinami 在爸爸那个世界的语境里终于够大、能听懂他的梗了，可他{i}还是{/i}不告诉她。也许他真的讨厌 Chinami？现在为什么大家都讨厌 Chinami？

lines.en: : I don’t think it’s possible {i}to{/i} hate you, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 我觉得{i}不可能{/i}有人讨厌你，Chinami。
: 你很可爱……也很有趣。

lines.en: : And it’s really easy to want to protect you when you can’t do anything on your own.
lines.zh: : 而且当你什么都做不了的时候，想保护你是件很容易的事。

lines.en: : Plus! The way you look at me sometimes is-
lines.zh: : 而且！你有时候看我的样子真是——
: 糟了。
: 爸爸？一切还好吗？
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHH!

lines.en: : Papa? What’s happening? You locked yourself in the bathroom for five whole minutes. Is your body also going through changes like Chinami’s probably is because of you?
lines.zh: : 爸爸？怎么了？你把自己锁在浴室里整整五分钟。你的身体也在经历变化吗——就像 Chinami 大概因为你而经历的那样？

lines.en: : I...should probably leave. I think that...being stuck in this body might be...influencing the way I think now. And that’s not a situation I should put you in...even {i}if{/i} we’re the same size now.
lines.zh: : 我……大概该走了。我觉得……困在这具身体里可能……正在影响我现在的思维方式。而我不该把你放进那种处境……{i}哪怕{/i}我们现在一样大。

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t understand. But if it’s because Papa is a lolicon, she thinks it’s probably okay for him to be one of those right now.
lines.zh: : Chinami 不明白。但如果是因为爸爸是萝莉控，她觉得他现在当萝莉控大概也没关系。
: Chinami……你喜欢我，对吧？
: AAAAAAAAHHHHHHH!

lines.en: : You don’t need to yell. I’m right here.
lines.zh: : 你不用喊。我就在这儿。

lines.en: : Papa is...dating Chinami’s big sister. It would be wrong for her to like him. Even if she heard her big sister say earlier that she...wanted this to happen for some reason?
lines.zh: : 爸爸……在跟 Chinami 的姐姐交往。她喜欢他就是不对的。就算她刚才听到姐姐说……她不知为何想让这事发生？

lines.en: : Forget Chika even exists for a second.
lines.zh: : 先当 Chika 根本不存在。
: AAAAAAAAHHHHHHH!

lines.en: : Okay. Never mind. She can still exist.
lines.zh: : 好吧。算了。她还可以存在。

lines.en: : But if you and I really were the same age...and she had never fallen for me...
lines.zh: : 但如果你我真的是同岁……而她从没爱上过我……
: 那会怎样？

lines.en: : When I go back to normal...will you forget this ever happened to me? Or will you wish somewhere deep within your heart that I just...stayed forever young?
lines.zh: : 等我变回正常……你会忘记这事发生在我身上过吗？还是你会在心底某处希望我就……永远保持年轻？
: 永远年轻？

lines.en: : I don’t think there’s much time left. There needed to be a title drop before it was too late.
lines.zh: : 我觉得没多少时间了。得趁还不太晚的时候把标题说出来。

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t understand what Papa is talking about with title drops, but...um...
lines.zh: : Chinami 不懂爸爸说的「标题」是什么意思，但……呃……

lines.en: : Can Chinami...be a little bit selfish for a second?
lines.zh: : Chinami 能……自私一小下吗？

lines.en: : Only if you’re willing to accept the consequences that will come from it. And will acknowledge that this might be more than just me hunting for excuses again.
lines.zh: : 前提是你愿意接受随之而来的后果。而且要承认，这可能不只是我又在找借口。
: 那……Chinami……

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t want you to go back! She wants you to stay here and be her friend! Maybe more! But she {i}also{/i} doesn’t want to miss her Papa! And she doesn’t want to make her sister sad!
lines.zh: : Chinami 不想让你变回去！她想让你留在这儿当她的朋友！也许更多！但她{i}也{/i}不想失去她的爸爸！而且她不想让她姐姐难过！

lines.en: : She doesn’t know what she wants! She’s never felt like this before and she’s scared! And she’s sorry she’s yelling! She wants to know what “consequences” Papa was talking about!
lines.zh: : 她不知道她想要什么！她以前从没这样感觉过，她很害怕！她为喊叫道歉！她想知道爸爸说的「后果」是什么！

lines.en: : She wants to know how he feels about her! She wants to know if he wants to be selfish too! And she wants him to know that it’s okay if he does! He can be selfish with Chinami!
lines.zh: : 她想知道他对她是什么感觉！她想知道他是不是也想自私一次！她想让他知道，就算他真想也没关系！他可以对 Chinami 自私！

lines.en: : Chinami loves him! No matter what size he is! But she obviously prefers him this way because it’s like one of the fairy tales she used to read when she was-
lines.zh: : Chinami 爱他！不管他是什么尺寸！但她显然更喜欢他这样，因为这就像她小时候读过的童话之一——
: Chinami……

lines.en: : Please don’t tell your sister what I am about to do.
lines.zh: : 请别告诉你姐姐我接下来要做什么。
: Chinami……她……呃……
: Mmm!
: Chinami！
: Tsukasa！
: 别动！

lines.en: : You keep choking me with my own necklace! Am I supposed to just sit here and let it happen?!
lines.zh: : 你一直用我自己的项链勒我！我就该坐在这儿任它发生吗？！

lines.en: : I wouldn’t be choking you at all if you’d only sit still! You brought this upon yourself by wearing fake diamonds to your own wedding. I swear, it’s like you {i}want{/i} to live in poverty.
lines.zh: : 你要是肯坐着不动，我根本不会勒到你！是你自己在自己的婚礼上戴假钻石，自找的。我发誓，你就像是{i}想{/i}过穷日子。

lines.en: : Just leave it the way it is! It was my mom’s! I don’t want you to ruin it twenty minutes before I’m supposed to go out there!
lines.zh: : 就让它那样吧！那是我妈的！我不想你在我要出去前二十分钟把它弄坏！

lines.en: : You’re going to go out there {i}on time?!{/i} You’re supposed to make him wait {i}at least{/i} half an hour! What kind of bride are you?!
lines.zh: : 你要{i}准时{/i}出去？！你本该让他{i}至少{/i}等上半小时！你算什么新娘？！

lines.en: : Oh, Yumi...they grow up so fast.
lines.zh: : 哦，Yumi……他们长得太快了。

lines.en: : Who exactly? Because those two haven’t changed in over a decade.
lines.zh: : 具体是谁？因为那两个十几年都没变过。

lines.en: : {i}Chinami{/i} obviously. I feel like it was just yesterday she couldn’t even go outside. Now she’s {i}here...{/i}getting ready to marry the love of her life.
lines.zh: : 当然是{i}Chinami{/i}。我感觉就像昨天她还连门都出不了。现在她{i}在这儿……{/i}准备嫁给她一生的挚爱。
: 我只是……我说不出话。
: 不过{i}你{/i}还好吗？
: 嗯？你什么意思？

lines.en: : What do you think I mean, Chika? She’s marrying your {i}ex.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你觉得我什么意思，Chika？她要嫁给你{i}前任{/i}了。

lines.en: : Yumi, that was fifteen years ago.
lines.zh: : Yumi，那是十五年前的事了。

lines.en: : Yeah, and you’ve been single ever since.
lines.zh: : 是啊，而你从那以后一直单身。

lines.en: : I just...haven’t met the right guy yet.
lines.zh: : 我只是……还没遇到对的人。

lines.en: : Plus — I like {i}older{/i} guys. Which means Akira wouldn’t even be on my radar nowadays since he never took Tsubasa’s offer and decided to stay young instead.
lines.zh: : 再说——我喜欢{i}年长{/i}的男人。也就是说现在 Akira 根本不会进入我的视野，因为他从没接受 Tsubasa 的提议，反而决定保持年轻。
: 那你没事？真的？

lines.en: : Chika! Can you help with my zipper? It’s stuck again.
lines.zh: : Chika！你能帮我弄下拉链吗？它又卡住了。
: 至少比 Ami 好。

lines.en: : Okay. You’re all set. And remember — if anything comes undone, it’s Kirin’s fault. Not mine.
lines.zh: : 好了。都弄好了。记住——要是有什么散开，那是 Kirin 的错。不是我的。

lines.en: : Thanks again for the suit on such short notice, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 这么临时还借我西装，再次谢谢你，Noriko。

lines.en: : Oh, please. Considering how forgetful you are, I’ve had this this thing ready to go for months.
lines.zh: : 哦，得了吧。考虑到你有多健忘，这东西我已经备着好几个月了。

lines.en: : How...{i}reliable.{/i} It’s still so unfortunate that his other tux just vanished out of nowhere.
lines.zh: : 真是……{i}可靠{/i}。不过他另一套礼服就那么凭空消失，还是太不幸了。

lines.en: : Ignore her. Are you excited? Finally pulling the trigger after all these years?
lines.zh: : 别理她。你兴奋吗？这么多年之后终于要扣动扳机了？

lines.en: : I’d be more excited if Niki were here.
lines.zh: : 要是 Niki 在这儿，我会更兴奋。
: 我试过了……真的试过了。
: 没问题。
: 我{i}确实{/i}很兴奋。

lines.en: : I just wish I could say the same for my daughter.
lines.zh: : 我只是希望我女儿也能这么说。

lines.en: : I probably shouldn’t comment any further on that though.
lines.zh: : 不过这事我大概不该再多评论。

lines.en: : Noriko...could I have a minute alone with my dad, please?
lines.zh: : Noriko……我能跟我爸单独待一分钟吗？

lines.en: : No problem. Akira — I love you. And remember-
lines.zh: : 没问题。Akira——我爱你。还有记住——

lines.en: : If anything comes undone, blame Kirin. Not you.
lines.zh: : 要是有什么散开，怪 Kirin。不怪你。

lines.en: : Bingo. Knock ‘em dead out there. I’ll be watching.
lines.zh: : 答对了。出去把他们震住。我会看着的。
: 你一直都是。

lines.en: : Blah blah blah. My turn. Bye, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 废话废话废话。轮到我了。再见，Noriko。
: Ami，听我说——

lines.en: : No, {i}you{/i} listen. You are making a mistake. It’s not supposed to end like this.
lines.zh: : 不，{i}你{/i}听我说。你在犯一个错误。它不该这样结束。
: 没有什么{i}要结束{/i}。我只是……要结婚了。

lines.en: : To the {i}wrong{/i} person. Because the world fucked up and {i}you{/i} didn’t have the balls to go back and fix it.
lines.zh: : 跟{i}错的{/i}人。因为这世界搞砸了，而{i}你{/i}没胆量回去修正它。

lines.en: : Can’t you just...be happy for me, please? Chinami had the courtesy to make you a bridesmaid and everything. She didn’t need to do that.
lines.zh: : 你就不能……为我高兴一下吗？Chinami 好心地让你当伴娘什么的。她本来不必这么做。

lines.en: : You expect me to be happy with a {i}consolation prize?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你指望我对一个{i}安慰奖{/i}感到高兴？

lines.en: : I expect you to be happy because {i}I{/i} am happy.
lines.zh: : 我指望你高兴，是因为{i}我{/i}高兴。
: 不用。
: {i}为什么？{/i}
: {i}我穿错了颜色。{/i}
: 你迟到了半小时。

lines.en: : Tsukasa talked me into it. She said it would make you love me more and also...something about showing you who’s really in charge, I think?
lines.zh: : Tsukasa 说服了我。她说这能让你更爱我，还有……我想是关于让你知道谁才是真正说了算的那个？
: 嗯，她错了。

lines.en: : I know. You’ve always liked to be {i}in charge{/i} when it comes to-
lines.zh: : 我知道。在……这方面你一直都喜欢{i}说了算{/i}——

lines.en: : Not that. It’s just not possible for me to love you any more.
lines.zh: : 不是那个。只是我不可能再更爱你了。

lines.en: : Oh no. I’m going to cry.
lines.zh: : 哦不。我要哭了。

lines.en: : That’s fine. Just don’t scream like you always do.
lines.zh: : 那没关系。只是别像你平时那样尖叫。

lines.en: : I might scream too. Will that ruin the wedding?
lines.zh: : 我可能也会尖叫。那会毁了婚礼吗？
: 不可能。

lines.en: : You underestimate my ability to ruin things.
lines.zh: : 你低估了我毁掉事情的能力。

lines.en: : And you underestimate just how lucky I am to be the one standing up here today.
lines.zh: : 而你也低估了我今天能站在这儿有多幸运。
: Akira……
: Chinami……
: Mmm!

lines.en: : What are you two doing?! You just got up there! There’s an entire speech we need to go through! You haven’t even read your vows yet! You-
lines.zh: : 你们两个在干什么？！你们才刚上台！还有一整段致辞要走！你们连誓词都还没念！你们——
: AAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHH!!!

lines.en: : Damn it. I thought she’d be able to hold back today.
lines.zh: : 该死的。我以为她今天能忍住。

lines.en: : Chinami! Get back here! You can’t lock yourself in the bathroom in the middle of your wedding!
lines.zh: : Chinami！给我回来！你不能在婚礼进行到一半的时候把自己锁在浴室里！

lines.en: : CHINAMI IS SORRY! SHE JUST NEEDS A MINUTE TO PROCESS ALL OF THIS! SHE’LL BE BACK IN A MINUTE! SHE SWEARS!
lines.zh: : Chinami 很抱歉！她只是需要一分钟消化这一切！她马上就回来！她发誓！

lines.en: : JEEVES! STAY RIGHT FUCKING THERE! DO NOT MOVE! DO YOU UNDERSTAND?! CHINAMI! GET BACK HERE!
lines.zh: : JEEVES！就他妈给我待在那儿！别动！你明白吗？！Chinami！给我回来！
: 我哪儿也不去。
